ELON MUSK: A true Kardashev-scale civilization will require infrastructure beyond Earth.

Musk says the future of advanced AI could eventually demand energy at a scale our planet alone may struggle to support. That’s why long-term growth may depend on Moon bases, mass drivers and massive space-based solar power systems.

According to Musk, solar-powered AI satellites launched at enormous scale could generate terawatt-level energy, but doing so would require millions of tons of payload reaching orbit every year.

The long-term vision goes even further. Lunar infrastructure and industrialization could eventually unlock petawatt-scale power generation, making today’s global economy look tiny by comparison.

The limiting factor is no longer physics. It’s how fast humanity can build.

Tesla Australia has officially opened its 1,000th Supercharger stall! 🇦🇺

The milestone was celebrated at Byron Bay with a custom-designed charger featuring coastal artwork and a special “No. 1000” plaque. The new site helps extend Tesla’s charging network across 10,000 km of major Australian road corridors, making EV travel easier than ever.

A huge achievement for Tesla’s growing infrastructure and Australia’s electric future.

Falcon 9 has successfully launched the NROL-179 mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base, delivering another critical payload for the National Reconnaissance Office. 🚀

The flight-proven booster completed its third mission and returned safely to Landing Zone 4, marking yet another flawless recovery.

Reliable launches. Rapid reusability. Continued progress in national security spaceflight.

BREAKING: Paraguay has partnered with Starlink to connect 1,600 schools with high-speed internet 🇵🇾

More than 50,000 students and teachers are expected to benefit, particularly in some of the country's most remote and underserved regions.

The initiative will also extend connectivity to healthcare centers, helping improve access to education, information and essential services nationwide.

As Paraguay's President stated, the goal is bigger than technology — it's about ensuring that where a child is born does not determine their opportunities to learn, grow and succeed. @elonmusk 

Starlink is helping bridge the digital divide, one community at a time.

BREAKING: President Trump praises Starlink while speaking about the new Air Force One.

"We have communication equipment up there that nobody's ever seen before, it's the highest level and including Starlink, my friend Elon is going to be very happy."

A remarkable moment for Starlink, as the satellite internet network continues to gain recognition at the highest levels of government and aviation.

I am completely blown away!!! 
It’s midnight and I’ve just wrapped up my first ever day on FSD v14.3.3!!

I honestly am in awe at what a professional driver my car is now! It has gone from being a cautious grandma, to an assertive boss!!

I doubted some of the guys on a space early this morning that it would be able to handle Australian roundabouts with expertise, and boy was I mistaken!!! This version NAILS roundabouts with ease! Not only does it enter them at a perfect speed, it accelerates out of them with full force and confidence! Legitimately brought a smile to my face. 

It’s now fully proactive and asserts itself with lane changes and makes sure that it gets into the right lane WELL IN ADVANCE before it has to take an exit. It now also consistently INDICATES every time 2 lanes merge into one. And the moment there’s a speed zone change it reacts immediately to either accelerate or de-accelerate without no delay!  Legitimately addresses all the complaints we previously had with FSD here in Australia!

Oh! And not to mention, it can find a supercharger in a basement of a building and park automatically now! When before it would bail at tight corners in underground carparks. 

This version feels like it now honours my time. It’s incredibly fast to react, decisive to make a move and has no hesitation in accelerating quickly to get up to speed. There’s no longer a trade-off with choosing FSD or getting to your destination in a hurry. It’ll make sure you get there safely and  effectively!

I freaking love FSD!!! Thank you so much to the incredible team and everyone else that made this happen! I am incredibly over the moon with this! Lots of love 🫶

Enjoy my full 2 hour video of FSD v14 here Down Under!! 🇦🇺🇦🇺
